name: Do I need permits for trip hazard repair in South San Francisco?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for trip hazard repair in South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for trip hazard repair can vary by municipality. For minor repairs like grinding or small patches, a permit is typically not required. However, if the repair involves significant structural work, altering drainage, or replacing large sections of public sidewalk, a permit from the City of South San Francisco's Public Works or Building Department might be necessary. It's always best to consult with us or the local authorities before starting major work to ensure compliance with all local codes and regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor trip hazard repairs usually don't need permits. Large structural work or public sidewalk replacements in South San Francisco may require one. It's best to check with us or local authorities.
